shadows.name: selected-auth-mode
shadows.purpose: Small separation for the selected sign-in mode only.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Removes authored movement when the user requests less motion.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Main state-changing action; disabled state stays readable.
components.css: .ds-button-primary { min-height: 2.55rem; padding: 0.55rem 0.9rem; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 0.45rem; color: #fff; background: #1c625e; font: 650 0.82rem ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; transition: transform 130ms cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1), background-color 150ms ease-out; } .ds-button-primary:hover:not(:disabled) { background: #174f4c; } .ds-button-primary:active { transform: scale(0.98); } .ds-button-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #bd8120; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-button-primary:disabled { border-color: #aebfba; color: #53676d; background: #dbe5e1; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Supporting action with a full border and surface fill.
components.css: .ds-button-secondary { min-height: 2.55rem; padding: 0.55rem 0.9rem; border: 1px solid #aebfba; border-radius: 0.45rem; color: #142c33; background: #fbfcfa; font: 650 0.82rem ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; transition: transform 130ms cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1), background-color 150ms ease-out; } .ds-button-secondary:hover:not(:disabled) { border-color: #6c8581; background: #f4f7f4; } .ds-button-secondary:active { transform: scale(0.98); } .ds-button-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #bd8120; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Full-width field with visible focus and readable placeholder.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 0.35rem; color: #142c33; font: 650 0.76rem ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-field input { width: 100%; min-height: 2.55rem; padding: 0.56rem 0.65rem; border: 1px solid #aebfba; border-radius: 0.38rem; color: #142c33; background: #fff; font: 450 0.83rem ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-field input::placeholder { color: #78878a; opacity: 1; } .ds-field input:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #bd8120; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Workspace Navigation Item
components.description: Familiar rail navigation with a quiet selected surface.
components.css: .ds-nav-item { min-height: 2.9rem; padding: 0.55rem 0.6rem; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 0.55rem; color: #e0e8e5; background: #17373b; text-align: left; font: 500 0.88rem ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; transition: background-color 150ms ease-out, color 150ms ease-out, transform 130ms cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1); } .ds-nav-item:hover { color: #fff; background: rgb(255 255 255 / 8%); } .ds-nav-item[aria-current="page"] { border-color: rgb(235 189 87 / 38%); color: #fff; background: rgb(235 189 87 / 12%); } .ds-nav-item:active { transform: scale(0.98); } .ds-nav-item:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #bd8120; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: State Tag
components.description: Compact semantic state; color is paired with a text label.
components.css: .ds-state-tag { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.38rem; padding: 0.28rem 0.48rem; border: 1px solid #bcd7c7; border-radius: 999px; color: #235a3a; background: #deece4; font: 700 0.68rem ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-dot { width: 0.4rem; height: 0.4rem; border-radius: 50%; background: #28634d; } .ds-state-tag:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #bd8120; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Data Panel
components.description: Flat, full-border container for tables and operation details.
components.css: .ds-data-panel { min-width: 0; padding: 1rem; border: 1px solid #c9d5d1; border-radius: 0.5rem; color: #142c33; background: #fbfcfa; font: 400 0.9rem/1.5 ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-data-panel h2 { margin: 0 0 0.5rem; font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 640; } .ds-data-panel p { margin: 0; color: #53676d; }

components.name: Release Stage Marker
components.description: Ordered progress marker where sequence is meaningful.
components.css: .ds-stage { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1rem auto; align-items: center; gap: 0.45rem; color: #142c33; font: 500 0.8rem ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, monospace; } .ds-stage-marker { display: grid; width: 1rem; height: 1rem; place-items: center; border: 1px solid #bd8120; border-radius: 50%; color: #5d4110; background: #f0cc78; font-size: 0.58rem; } .ds-stage small { grid-column: 2; color: #53676d; font: 400 0.66rem ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-stage:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #bd8120; outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.overview: CloudScale is a working surface for changing configuration deliberately. The visual language is restrained and confident: clear scope, legible state, and a short path from inspection to action. A deep teal navigation rail anchors the light workspace; amber marks active release progress, while green and red remain semantic.
keyCharacteristics: Configuration state is visible before mutation.
The release timetable appears only where stages carry operational meaning.
Monospaced text is reserved for keys, IDs, and measured values.
Borders and tonal surfaces carry hierarchy; motion is brief state feedback.

rules.name: The Signal-Only Rule
rules.body: Amber is reserved for active progression or caution; it is not a general decorative accent.

rules.name: The Data-Has-a-Job Rule
rules.body: Monospaced type is used only when values benefit from alignment or code-like distinction.

rules.name: The Border-First Rule
rules.body: Use a full border or surface tint before adding elevation. Reserve shadows for a specific interaction state.

dos: Do keep organization, project, and environment scope visible before an operation.
Do use green, red, and amber only for their established semantic states.
Do keep focus visible and honor reduced-motion preferences.
Do show loading, empty, validation, permission, success, and error states honestly.
donts: Don't add percentage exposure to Evaluation until the feature-value contract defines treatment/control behavior.
Don't imply automatic rollback; health observations pause rollouts and rollback is manual.
Don't add decorative section numbering, arbitrary dashboards, broad drop shadows, or fake/demo actions.
Don't use monospace for ordinary labels or body copy.
